scope: Active addressable theorem inventory; historical execution receipts remain immutable. Finite examples do not discharge general claims.

axioms.B1: Positive unital real Jordan-Lie observables with displayed identities E1/E2 and all positive normalized states/effects.
axioms.B2: Locally tomographic composition compatible with unit, Jordan product and bracket.
axioms.B3: All nonzero idempotent compressions and nontrivial distinguishability.
axioms.B4: Exactly all ancillary-positive subunital events; full process availability.
axioms.P: Every state is a marginal of a pure state of an available composite.

claims.title: Finite polynomial onset or invariance
hypotheses: finite real linear flow x'=Ax; polynomial residual f of finite degree; f(m)=0
exact full symmetric-power lift and cyclic subspace at m
claims.formalization: Written general proof; exact rational finite lift/annihilator checker. No general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Pair defects and connected cumulants
hypotheses: fixed finite quantum system and Hamiltonian
include every component polynomial of the declared pair defect or connected cumulant; exact jets
claims.formalization: Written specialization; finite symbolic checks. No general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Finite cancellation stratification
hypotheses: fixed finite family of allowed supports and local dimensions
polynomial parameterization of the Hamiltonian and initial data within stated constraints
claims.formalization: Written proof with finite cancellation controls; no Lean stratification theorem.

claims.title: Constructive sharp incidence-qubit tree family
hypotheses: declared finite tree; one incidence qubit per incident edge
specified product initial state, interaction and readout
claims.proof_anchor: **Proposition 5.19 (a constructive sharp family for every finite tree).**
claims.formalization: Written construction plus finite checks; not generic sharpness for arbitrary one-qubit-per-vertex Hamiltonians; no Lean theorem.

claims.title: Boundary-checked local persistent zero
hypotheses: finite region R and full declared finite Hamiltonian term list
independent Hermitian basis containing identity; invariant under i[H_R,·]
every crossing term commutes with every basis operator
declared polynomial readout and initial region state; sufficient full jets or cyclic annihilator
claims.formalization: Exact Gaussian-rational finite model/annihilator checker; local dimension <=8, boundary union dimension <=64, lift dimension <=256. Written general proof; no general Lean theorem. Field-by-field full cumulant coverage remains a premise.

claims.title: Leading-coefficient measurement protocol
hypotheses: specified leading Taylor order and nonzero coefficient
declared readout, simultaneous measurement error and remainder bound
claims.proof_anchor: ### 5.17 Sharp onset, algebraic cancellation, and local zero certificates
claims.formalization: Written error propagation; finite illustrative checks. No laboratory evaluation or Lean theorem.

claims.title: Augmented quotient observability
hypotheses: declared finite-dimensional cochain complex and norm
closure observation plus retained cohomology observation with the stated kernel property
claims.formalization: Written general result; finite linear-algebra examples. Closure alone does not detect nonzero retained H1; no general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Physical obstruction and measurement error
hypotheses: declared local product observables with maximum arity k and operator norm at most one
oriented cycle-gradient repairs and normalized mean-l1 norm
corrected joint-minus-product moments
simultaneous absolute error epsilon on each joint and factor moment, supplied as a premise
claims.formalization: Written general theorem. Separate finite measurement records invoke the canonical Rust Phi1 witness calculation and independently replay bound max(Phi1/(k+1)-epsilon,0). No general Lean theorem and no laboratory-coverage verification. Positive quotient can occur in separable correlated states.

claims.title: Ising ring onset and pair blindness
hypotheses: homogeneous declared nearest-neighbor Ising ring and product initial state
specified local Pauli observables, support and time window
claims.proof_anchor: **Corollary 7.11 (Ising rings, a uniform onset window, and pair blindness).**
claims.formalization: Written proof plus symbolic finite checks. Pair blindness does not imply productness; no general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Associative complexification and positive faithful representation
hypotheses: B1 real unital symmetric Jordan product and antisymmetric Lie bracket
Jacobi, derivation, signed associator identity (E1), positive invariant inner product (E2)
finite nonzero real observable space; complex bilinear extension and conjugation
claims.formalization: Lean 4.34.0 / Mathlib v4.34.0 E.1 component (two modules) of the scoped three-module E.1/E.6 target: associativity, involution, faithful multiplicative left representation, adjoint identity, positive squares, closed finite-dimensional C*-image, self-adjoint part and positive-cone equality from the complexified B1 identities. Seventeen axiom reports within propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. The real-to-complex input construction remains a written argument; E.2-E.5 are not formalized by this target.

claims.title: Block structure and Born pairing
hypotheses: B1 and complete states/effects
finite-dimensional complex C*-algebra block decomposition; spectral positive cone
claims.formalization: Written proof using finite-dimensional C*-structure theorem and trace duality. Pauli/density/effect checks are examples; block classification is not Lean formalized.

claims.title: Standard composition and corners
hypotheses: B2 real local tomography and unit/product/bracket-preserving local maps
B3 availability of every nonzero idempotent compression
claims.formalization: Written tensor/corner identification; finite compression examples, no general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Complete base classification
hypotheses: B1-B3 including nontrivial distinguishability and tensor/corner closure
B4 when identifying all events, tests and channels
claims.formalization: Written three-family classification within the stated base. Not a classification of all general probabilistic theories; no general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Quantum selector by purification
hypotheses: B1-B4 and pure-state purification P
full reversible channels for the equivalent continuous pure-state transitivity characterization
claims.formalization: Written selector with classical/superselection deletion countermodels and explicit finite purification/Kraus checks. Neither B1-B4 nor P is inferred from obstruction data. No general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Tangent-restricted affine-subspace chart transfer
hypotheses: M relatively open in a closed affine subspace
chart inherited from a continuous affine isomorphism of that subspace
C2 retraction and the generator hypothesis of Theorem 3.1
the compared derivative is the tangent restriction
claims.formalization: Written chain-rule proof. Exact symbolic checks of Example 3.3 and Remark 3.3.1. No Lean theorem. S1 remains open when the second fundamental form is nonzero.

claims.title: Unqualified ambient nonconstancy does not force chart nonlinearity
hypotheses: no extra nondegeneracy hypothesis
claims.formalization: Explicit Euclidean contraction semigroup, graph retraction, and chart calculation. The finite replay checks the same identities.

claims.title: Vertical graph chart derivative and noncancellation test
hypotheses: E and F are closed complementary subspaces
vertical retraction Pi(e+n)=e+f(e) onto a C2 graph
A is bounded or satisfies the graph-norm hypothesis of Theorem 3.1
the chart reads phi(m(u))=u
In the unbounded case the graph parameterization is graph-norm C2; separately written A h and A Df h require compatible domains.
claims.formalization: Written differentiation of the E-component. Exact symbolic checks of Example 3.4, including the cancellation case P_E A|_F=0. No Lean theorem. S1 remains open when the retraction moves the chart coordinate or the submanifold is not presented as a graph.

claims.title: Constant-shear graph chart derivative
hypotheses: E and F are closed complementary subspaces
L from F to E is bounded and linear
Pi = m composed with g(e,n)=e+L(n-f(e))
A is bounded or satisfies the graph-norm hypothesis of Theorem 3.1
In the unbounded case the graph parameterization is graph-norm C2; separately written A h and A Df h require compatible domains.
claims.formalization: Written product rule for the constant shear. Exact symbolic checks of Example 3.5. L=0 recovers Lemma 3.4. No Lean theorem. S1 remains open for a nonlinear fiber displacement and for a submanifold not presented as a graph.

claims.title: Canonical positive invariant trace witness
hypotheses: finite real commutative unital bilinear algebra and antisymmetric bracket
derivation and normalized signed associator identities
every element has a supplied real orthogonal nonzero-idempotent spectral decomposition
claims.formalization: Scoped Lean 4.34.0 proof: trace compatibility and positive definiteness for supplied spectral witnesses; scalar inhabitant; nine standard-axiom reports. No inner product assumed; no operational reconstruction.

claims.title: Sharp central-weight purification obstruction

standard block tensor product
simple ancilla dimension at least maximum block rank for attainment
claims.formalization: Written general proof; rational finite attainment and sector-swap controls. No general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Edge-decomposed TDVP Duhamel bound

product density trajectory solving the stated mean-field ODE
marginal-product derivative restricted to Hermitian trace-zero variations; affine extension distinguished from feasible boundary cone
independently proved conditional-expectation residual bounds or applicable LR constants
claims.formalization: Written conditional theorem; sampled numerical output is not an enclosure or a proof of the LR premise. No general Lean theorem.

claims.title: Site-factorized cut-edge Pythagorean rate
